title: Figure 22. The Impact of Frequency Noise Improvements on FDMA and FHSS
description: Two color bar charts of power spectral density (PSD) versus frequency. Panel "(a) Frequency Division Multiple Access" compares a "High Freq Noise Case" with "Larger Guard Bands" to a "Low Freq Noise Case" with "Smaller Guard Bands"; panel "(b) Frequency Hop Spread Spectrum" contrasts "Fewer Freq Symbols" with "More Freq Symbols". Page also covers section "3.4 Possible Future Upgrades to the FTS Devices" on optical lattice clocks.
